products.product_description: Rosemary Poppyseed crackers, net wt. 6 oz., packaged in clear poly bag with a twist tie. No UPC code. The label is read in parts: "***Ingredients: Flour, Baking Powder, Salt, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Fresh Rosemary, Poppyseeds. This bag may contain one or more of the following allergens: Soy, Wheat Flour, Eggs, Milk/Dairy, Peanuts, Tree Nuts***.
products.reason_for_recall: Rosemary Poppyseed crackers, net wt. 6 oz, are recalled due to undeclared wheat. Flour was declared but wheat was not declared in the Ingredients statement.
